verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs list single-tenant and BYOC (bring-your-own-cloud) deployment options alongside the default multi-tenant service, so the core product can run in the customer's own cloud environment. That is a glancing approximation of self-hosting, not true self-hosting: the evidence describes no install path, and a community commenter notes the product is source-unavailable, so users cannot run it themselves. Missing for 10: downloadable or open-source distribution, self-managed installation and operations docs, details on how BYOC divides control between customer and vendor, independent hands-on corroboration of self-run deployments.
